# 2 Chronicles 10 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Chronicles 10 (19 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 6

---

## V.5
- **EMET:** "And-he-said to-them go-away for-three days and-return to-me and-the-people went."
- **LOGOS:** "He said to them, "Come to me again in three days." So the people went away."
- **PNEUMA:** "Rehoboam answered, "Come back to me in three days." So the people left."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.6
- **EMET:** "And-he-consulted the-king Rehoboam with the-elders who were standing before Solomon his-father in-his-being alive saying how are-you advising to-retur"
- **LOGOS:** "Then King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men who had stood before Solomon his father while he was yet alive, saying, "How do you advise me to answ"
- **PNEUMA:** "King Rehoboam consulted the elders who had served his father Solomon during his lifetime. "What is your advice?" he asked. "How should I respond to th"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.7
- **EMET:** "And-they-spoke to-him saying if you-are good to this people and-you-please-them and-you-speak to-them words good then-they-will-be to-you servants all"
- **LOGOS:** "And they said to him, "If you will be good to this people and please them and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants forever.""
- **PNEUMA:** "They replied, "If you are kind to these people and please them by giving them a favorable answer, they will serve you forever.""
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.12
- **EMET:** "And-he-came Jeroboam and-all the-people to Rehoboam on-the-day the-third as-that spoke the-king saying return to-me on-the-day the-third."
- **LOGOS:** "So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king said, "Come to me again the third day.""
- **PNEUMA:** "Three days later, Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam, as the king had said, "Come back in three days.""
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.17
- **EMET:** "And-sons-of Israel the-dwelling in-cities-of Judah and-he-reigned over-them Rehoboam."
- **LOGOS:** "But Rehoboam reigned over the people of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah."
- **PNEUMA:** "But Rehoboam still ruled over the Israelites living in the towns of Judah."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.19
- **EMET:** "And-they-rebelled Israel against-house-of David to this day."
- **LOGOS:** "So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day."
- **PNEUMA:** "Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David ever since."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.
